scope: Queue reuse and real YaShell page navigation only; not a full player scenario

fixture.background: clear glass with synthetic aura colors

method.queue_pair: 12 warmed collection-to-queue pairs per condition, processEvents after each pair; animations disabled to isolate rebuild cost
method.baseline: same current code with queue.refresh(force=True), representing unconditional widget rebuilding
method.optimized: queue.refresh() reuses unchanged widgets and scroll position
method.rapid: 16 alternating collection/queue requests without event-loop drains; final incoming snapshot then prepared
method.background: two empty stack-area pixels compared between a real window grab crop and the new ancestor-aware transition capture

limitations: Offscreen elapsed navigation timings, not live display FPS or a Spotify comparison. Original measurement completed, then its cleanup attempted to access the closed page's node; cleanup was corrected separately without repeating navigation.
